displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 32 is 3 short and 2 long
meaning: Low-heat pressure switch did not close, or it reopened. If it stays open longer than five minutes, the inducer shuts off for 15 minutes before a retry. If it opens during the blower on-delay, the blower comes on for the selected blower off-delay.
causes: Vent sizing is wrong, or the vent is restricted
Defective inducer motor or a low 115 V supply to the inducer
Low inlet gas pressure, if a low-gas-pressure switch is used
Excessive wind or inadequate combustion air
diySteps: Look at the outdoor intake and exhaust terminations for snow, ice, leaves, or a nest. Leave the pipes connected
Count 3 short flashes and 2 long flashes before you cut power. A 15-minute inducer pause is the control waiting, not a repair
Technician: check vent sizing, the inducer and its 115 V supply, the pressure switch, inlet gas pressure if an LGPS is used, and the pressure tubing
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the terminations are clear and 32 returns. Never jumper a pressure switch.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
